assembly_context.name: FiveAxisRoboticArm_Assembly
assembly_context.summary: 基于SolidWorks API自动生成一个五轴串联机械臂装配体。包含底座、大臂、小臂、手腕旋转部、末端法兰及5根连接轴。所有连杆简化为带安装凸台的圆柱体，轴为标准圆柱零件。初始姿态为竖直向上伸直状态。
design_rules: All dimensions in mm, convert to meters for modeling code.
Initial pose: All links aligned along +Z axis.
Shafts are standard cylinders, length slightly larger than link width for assembly clearance.
Links are simplified as cylinders with mounting bosses at ends.

instances.name: Base Instance
instances.placement_notes: Origin at bottom center. Aligned with Global CS.

assembly_sequence: Insert inst_link1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j1.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_base.top_face_boss (or offset)
Insert inst_link2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j2.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link1.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j3.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link2.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j4.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_wrist1.end_face_top

part.name: Base Plate
part.function: Fixed base of the robot arm, supports J1 rotation.
part.shape: Rectangular block with a central cylindrical boss on top. Height 80mm, Width 100mm (square footprint). Central boss diameter 40mm, height 10mm.
part.material_or_notes: Steel or Aluminum. Fixed to ground.

faces.name: top_face_boss
faces.purpose: Interface for J1 shaft and Link1 bottom

assembly_relation_notes: Top face boss aligns with Link1 bottom hole via J1 shaft.
standalone_modeling_instructions: Sketch rectangle 100x100 on XY plane, extrude 80mm up.
On top face, sketch circle dia 40mm centered, extrude 10mm up.
